clauses.quote: Each student shall have access to a school library media center
clauses.notes: Student entitlement; acting_party is 'other' as students are not bargaining unit members.

clauses.quote: each center shall be equally equipped in accordance with accreditation standards.
School library media resources shall be selected in accordance with the philosophy and objectives of the Birmingham Board of Education and the local school
clauses.notes: Second independent clause in source ('and, shall support...') skipped as descriptive/policy-intro.

clauses.quote: Radio and television programs, together with other media such as films, may be incorporated into instructional programs
clauses.subject_text: Radio and television programs, together with other media such as films

clauses.quote: Instructional television shall be made available to all students.
An adequate production and distribution system will be maintained to the extent that funds are available.
clauses.subject_text: An adequate production and distribution system

clauses.quote: ITV and all the technologies thereof will support the instructional program.
clauses.subject_text: ITV and all the technologies thereof
clauses.notes: Internal operational duty; 'ITV' is OCR for 'TV and all'.

clauses.quote: Appropriate personnel shall participate in the proper design and supervision of these activities.
Field trips should originate with the teacher
clauses.notes: Advisory guideline rather than strict duty.

clauses.quote: but must be approved by the Superintendent or his designee.
Field trips must provide students with extended learning opportunities.
clauses.notes: Implicitly obligates planners/teachers to ensure educational value.

clauses.quote: Priority must be given to the safety of the students.
